provenance.aws_batch_values: read from the existing AWS account
provenance.historical_claims: manifest values independently checked against Glue and Athena entity counts
provenance.layout_migration: S3 objects were relocated from region=quebec/ymd=20261108/ to region=quebec/2026/11/08/ on 2026-11-10; the run itself wrote the old layout. The manifest object's embedded output.prefix still records the prefix at run time.

processing.duration_note: Manifest duration ends when the manifest is generated, before final S3 publication and cleanup. CloudWatch's Run complete duration includes publication; Batch startedAt-to-stoppedAt also includes container startup/shutdown.
processing.file_rotation_observation: This historical run used the older writer, which rotated at 300000 rows. Current repository code rotates at 250000 rows and was run in AWS for the Monaco tutorial validation, but each Monaco entity fit in a single file, so the rotation threshold itself remains unexercised in AWS. Existing S3 data was not changed by the code; it was relocated to the yyyy/mm/dd layout on 2026-11-10.

related_overlapping_job.failure_reason: ECR GetAuthorizationToken connection timeouts during task initialization
related_overlapping_job.final_attempt: succeeded and parsed/published the same input partition while the benchmark job was also running

compute.concurrency_note: The two Quebec jobs overlapped on the same region/date partition. Both CloudWatch logs report successful processing and publication; the final S3 manifest names this benchmark job. There is no distributed partition lock, and duplicate compute was used.
compute.image_tag_mutability: AWS Batch described a latest tag; the digest was not recorded in the manifest

validation.athena_manifest_note: Athena returned zero rows for _manifest_json because underscore-prefixed files are skipped by the underlying file reader; the manifest object itself was read from S3 and parsed successfully.
validation.athena_scan_note: Athena reported zero scanned bytes; preserve this as the service-reported statistic, not as evidence that the entity data occupied zero bytes.

cost.note: No billing or cost allocation record was collected for this benchmark.
